meta.description: V1 local Coldplay-inspired GBK demo. Fictional operational assumptions are editable. Send this snapshot to the API when Optimize is selected.

projection.admission_mapping: Festival viewing tier is standing; CAT 1–8 are seated. Packages retain their underlying viewing tier.
projection.infinity_rule: Split the existing 500-person Infinity cohort using its fixed viewing-tier allocation; all splits keep the original arrival entry area.
projection.count_rule: Preserve expected arrivals as expected_attendees_estimate. Do not infer sold/issued tickets, quota or no-show rates.
projection.source_titles: Descriptive labels for the fixture's existing source URLs; no additional research was performed.

demo_assumptions: The existing 70,000 expected arrivals are represented by fictional sold counts with zero no-shows for deterministic demo conservation.
Each proposed entry area uses an illustrative four-lane admission template with four scan operators, four security officers and one help agent.
Visitors pass the help desk before security and then ticket scan and wristband. The fictional help visit share is editable in each behavior profile.

Admission paths follow mapped 7.5 m pedestrian or stadium-ring corridors. East, southeast and northwest stations are relocated from the original illustrative anchors because their original roads cannot fit four lanes. Equipment, widths and operational use require site review; these are not confirmed event gates.
Behavior profiles define fictional arrival windows, group sizes of two or four, and walking speeds from 1.0 to 1.25 m/s.
Rates, queue dimensions, costs, capacity, staff genders, targets and opening policies are fictional demo inputs.
The browser previews walking, FIFO waits and fixed-time admission service. Pedestrian interactions, crowd density and safe capacity are outside the local model.

Each bound operator serves one person at a time in FIFO order using typical step times and the configured operating hours. Security waits use the authored barrier pens. Overflow and waits without an authored pen appear in queue counts. People still waiting after closing remain queued.
Arriving groups are assigned round-robin across four authored lanes and keep that assignment through admission.

Behavior profiles, origin shares and category mixes are fictional inputs. The 76 category × behavior rows expand into 228 origin-specific runtime cohorts with exact attendee conservation. Category handovers remain near the admitted entrance endpoint until internal sector routes are reviewed.

MRT Exit B and drop-off coordinates use existing public OSM nodes. Parkir Timur uses a mapped polygon centroid with one explicitly proposed exit connector. Designating the parking entrance for taxi or app-based passenger drop-off is fictional; no vehicle movement is modeled.

approach_network.access_policy: Footway/pedestrian/path/steps/living_street/service; exclude access=no/private/customers and foot=no/private on ways and nodes. Area polygon boundaries are not walking links. Only rendered segments; intersections require a shared OSM node. Exclude paths that cross installed kit except the explicitly flagged East review leg.
limitations: OSM access and illustrative path widths need event review.
No accessible-routing, opening-hours, crossing-signal or vehicle-traffic model.
The East Festival approach overlaps its own middle barrier row on one mapped leg pending site review.

profiles.label: Early fan
profiles.behavior: Arrives early and keeps the assigned category queue.

profiles.label: Regular attendee
profiles.behavior: Walks from the onsite approach to the assigned entrance.

profiles.label: Late arrival
profiles.behavior: Joins the assigned entrance later in the admission period.

profiles.label: Package holder
profiles.behavior: Uses the package category entry area and an earlier arrival profile.

profiles.label: Social group
profiles.behavior: Arrives together and shares a slower group walking speed.

behavior_context.destination_scope: Post-security category handover at the assigned entrance. Internal routes to seats and standing sectors require venue review.
behavior_context.spawn_scope: Pedestrians spawn at mapped MRT Istora Mandiri Exit B, mapped Parkir Timur centroid or a fictional passenger drop-off at a mapped parking entrance. No vehicle traffic is modeled. Legacy entrance arrival IDs remain fallback bindings.
